# Web view: test plan checklist in the live tester's panel ## What to build In `--web`, clicking the live tester node (`@tester`) shows a checklist of the test plan cases for the latest review round. Each row shows: - the case id; - the title; - a priority badge (`must` / `should`); - a verdict badge (`pass` / `fail` / `blocked`); - the evidence, which expands when you click the row. The data already exists. Every review round ends with the event `review:end` `{ round, reports: Report[] }`. The tester report (`reviewer: "tester"`) has `cases: [{ id, verdict, evidence?, title?, priority? }]`, and the tool fills `title` and `priority` from the plan. The store doesn't listen to `review:end` today. This slice makes these changes: 1. The store listens to `review:end` and puts the tester's cases on `state.agents.tester.testPlan`. 2. That reaches the page as `graph.nodes.find(n => n.id === "@tester").view.testPlan` through the existing SSE `state` snapshot. 3. The KAN-7 node side panel renders the checklist. When there is no plan, nothing changes. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `src/runner/events.ts`: - `ReviewAgent` (line 26); - `"review:start"` and `"review:end"` (lines 102-103), emitted from `src/review/phase.ts:124` and `:128`. - `src/runner/nodes.ts` (lines 6-11): `AGENT_NODE`, which maps `tester` to `"@tester"`. - `src/ui/store.ts` (253 lines): - `NodeView` (lines 18-32); - `ViewState.agents` (lines 47-67); - the tester initialized at line 98; - the event handlers in the constructor (lines 110-188). `nodeChanges` (lines 114-120) is the pattern for routing data to an agent: it calls `setAgent(agent, { changes })`; - `run:restart` (lines 147-169) resets non-done nodes with `{...node, status...}`; - `setAgent` (lines 217-219) and `patch` (lines 221-224). - `src/ui/store.test.ts`: the store test pattern (emit on a `RunEmitter`, then read `store.getState()`). - `src/web/server.ts` (lines 60-77): `snapshot()`. Each node's `view` is the `NodeView`, so no server change is needed. - `src/web/page.html` (578 lines, plain JS): - panel CSS at lines 46-60 (`#panel`, `.phead`, `.fail`, `.totals`, `.none`) and badges at line 66; - globals at lines 109-117 (`state`, `selected`, `panelId`, `expanded`); - `div(cls, text)` (lines 291-296) and `para(cls, text)` (lines 232-237, a `
`);
  - `renderPanel(s)` (lines 373-437). It builds the skeleton once per selected node (`if (panelId !== id) { ... panel.replaceChildren(head, div("fail"), div("totals"), div("none", "No changes yet"), files); }`), then fills the slots on every render;
  - file rows expand by click at lines 338-364 (`makeRow`), the pattern for expanding evidence;
  - `main()` (lines 541-575) handles the SSE stream and node clicks.
- `src/web/server.test.ts` (lines 15-26 for `setup()`, lines 65-77 for the snapshot test): how to assert on `/state`.
- `TESTING.md` (lines 52-71): the manual agent-browser check of the web view. No automated test drives the page DOM.

## Patterns to follow

**Store type:**
```ts
export interface TestPlanView {
  round: number;
  cases: Array<{ id: string; title?: string; priority?: "must" | "should"; verdict: "pass" | "fail" | "blocked"; evidence?: string }>;
}
// NodeView gains:
testPlan?: TestPlanView;
```

**Store handler (mirror `nodeChanges`):**
```ts
events.on("review:end", ({ round, reports }) => {
  const cases = reports.find((r) => r.reviewer === "tester")?.cases;
  if (cases) this.setAgent("tester", { testPlan: { round, cases } });
});
```

On `run:restart`, keep `testPlan`; it shows the last finished round. Check that the existing spread keeps the field.

**Page:**

- Add a `div("plan")` slot to the skeleton, between `fail` and `totals`.
- On each render, fill it when `node.view.testPlan` is set; otherwise hide it.
- Layout:
  - a header line `Test plan, round N: 7/8 passed (1 blocked)`;
  - one row per case: `must P1 Login with an expired token returns 401 fail`.
- Clicking a row toggles a `
` with the evidence.
- Keep the set of open rows in a `Set` keyed by case id, the way `expanded` keeps open files, so SSE updates don't collapse them.
- Add CSS for `.v-pass` (green), `.v-fail` (red) and `.v-blocked` (amber). Use the existing color variables in the page's `:root`, if any, or the colors the `.add`/`.del` classes use (lines 64-65).
- Escape everything: set text with `textContent` only, never `innerHTML`. Evidence comes from an agent.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/ui/store.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `TestPlanView`, `NodeView.testPlan`, and the `review:end` handler.
- **IMPORTS**: none new, beyond what `events.ts` already exports (`Report` comes through the event type).
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/ui/store.test.ts`

### UPDATE `src/web/page.html`
- **IMPLEMENT**: the plan slot, its render and expand logic, and the CSS.
- **GOTCHA**:
  - The skeleton is built once per selected node (`panelId !== id`). Read the children by position the same way the existing code does (`const [head, fail, totals, none, list] = panel.children;`), and update that destructuring for the new slot.
  - The "No changes yet" text must not appear for the tester just because it has no file changes when a plan is shown. Hide `none` when the plan slot is visible and there are no changes.
  - `dist/web/page.html` is copied at build (`postbuild`). Edit only `src/web/page.html`.

### ADD tests
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `store.test.ts`: emitting `review:end` with a tester report that has cases sets `agents.tester.testPlan` with its round. One without cases leaves it unset. A second `review:end` replaces it.
  - `server.test.ts`: after `review:end`, `/state` has `graph.nodes` with `@tester` whose `view.testPlan.cases` has the cases.
  - Mirror `server.test.ts:65-77` for the setup. If `graph.nodes` needs graph metadata in `setup()`, look at how the existing snapshot test passes `meta`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/ui src/web`

### MANUAL check (document it in your final message, don't automate it)
- Build with `npm run build`.
- Start a fake run with `--web` on a tasks folder that has a `test-plan.json` (copy `src/__fixtures__/plan-ok`), following `TESTING.md` lines 52-71.
- Click the live tester and check the checklist.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] After a review round with a plan, `/state` carries `@tester` `view.testPlan = { round, cases }`.
- [ ] Clicking the live tester in the web view shows one row per case, with id, title, priority badge and verdict badge. Clicking a row shows its evidence, and open rows stay open across live updates.
- [ ] The rows show the latest round only.
- [ ] Without a plan, the tester's panel is unchanged.
- [ ] Evidence and titles are rendered as text (no HTML injection).
- [ ] Tests pass: `npx vitest run src/ui src/web`

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npx vitest run src/ui src/web
npm run build
```
